images.two_paths_together: Two small lanterns standing side by side on a rocky desert path at dusk, their warm lights merging into one glow, a sense of two brothers walking together, mountains in the distance.
images.mountain_light_dawn: A majestic rocky mountain at dawn with soft golden light rising behind it, a quiet valley below, holy and calm atmosphere.
images.palace_columns_dusk: Massive ancient Egyptian stone columns with simple geometric painted patterns at dusk, long shadows, a wide river behind, cold and grand, nobody present.
images.camp_tents_desert: A large desert encampment of many simple tents at the foot of a rocky mountain under a clear evening sky, campfires glowing softly, nobody visible.
images.gold_jewelry_pile: A pile of shiny golden bracelets, rings and necklaces lying on a woven cloth on the sand, glittering in the light of a campfire, slightly ominous mood.
images.dark_clouds_camp: Dark heavy clouds gathering over a desert tent camp in the evening, a single warm lantern glowing at one tent entrance, tense but not scary.
images.lantern_alone_tent: One small brave oil lantern glowing steadily at the entrance of a tent while other tents around are dark, night, hopeful and courageous mood.
images.mountain_path_return: A rocky mountain path leading down toward a desert tent camp at sunrise, two flat stone tablets resting on a rock beside the path, golden light.
images.two_palms_storm_calm: Two tall palm trees leaning toward each other after a storm, the sky clearing with soft golden light breaking through, calm and reconciliation.
images.starry_peace_sky: A peaceful starry night sky over quiet desert hills, a soft band of stars, calm and blessed atmosphere.
